_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — placeholders, never real people.
Copy to pilot-household.local.json (git-ignored) and fill in the real
pilot household there. Never commit the filled file, and never copy its
contents into a migration, into supabase/seed.sql, into a committed test
fixture, into documentation, or into a source-code constant (ADR-034).
Ages are product context only: there is deliberately no dateOfBirth field
and no age field — do not add one without an approved, privacy-safe design.

adultPilotIdentity._comment: The single authenticated adult used for the pilot. The password is supplied at bootstrap time via the environment, never stored here.

rotation._comment: Fixed, deterministic sequence between the child profiles. Order is significant.

chores._comment: Schedule and frequency are approval decisions — these are placeholders, not defaults to ship.
